recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a dynamic three-point landing pose amidst a chaotic explosion of fire, ice, and floating stone debris, set against a dark, starry cosmic sky and a desolate desert landscape.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered as the eye of the elemental storm
Contrast between warm fire and cool ice/space tones
Shattered rocks creating a sense of depth and motion
High-contrast lighting emphasizing the subject's form
coreInvariants: Dark, starry sky transition to desert ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, large scale, occupying the vertical center from bottom to mid-top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's grounded hand and forward-facing knee.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the debris and elemental trails around the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark corners of the cosmic sky provide breathing room for the busy central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and blues of the cosmic sky and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow of the fire explosion.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the top-left typographic block.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the fire and text; low saturation in the landscape and subject's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between light and dark

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into a single cohesive block
Variable heights within words to create a jagged silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display block paired with small, clean sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, blocky foundation needed for the display text.
Captures the interlocking and distressed nature of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cinematic scene of a man in a red and black patterned jacket performing a three-point landing in a desert. Surround him with a massive explosion of fire on one side and splashing water/ice on the other. Include floating, jagged rock debris and a dark, starry nebula sky above.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, slanted, blocky yellow text graphic in the top left corner with heavy black outlines. The text should appear as a single, solid, interlocking unit with distressed edges.

verificationChecks: Is the text bright yellow with a thick black outline?
Is the subject in a dynamic crouch pose?
Are fire and ice elements both present?
Are there floating rocks creating depth?

adjustableVariables: Density of the stars in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or specific artist names
Parental advisory logo (use a generic placeholder if needed)

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic integration of fire and ice effects.
Ensure the yellow text pops against the dark background.
Verify the perspective of the floating rocks matches the scene.
Confirm the subject's pose feels grounded and powerful.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Subject] + [Elemental Explosion: Fire/Ice] + [Floating Debris] + [Cosmic Sky] + [Heavy Blocky Yellow Typography with Black Outlines].
